plugins.name: Agenda

plugins.readme:
Zeff's Agenda as a plugin: notes on a timeline, in projects, like the app Agenda. A note has a date or a range, can be put on the

plugins.name: Auto actions

plugins.readme:
The AI step after the briefing, as a plugin. Generated by Zeff's `scripts/port-auto-actions.mts`.

Zeff's **Learn** — a skill tree, spaced repetition, experience, levels, a streak — rebuilt as an **external plugin**, using only what an
